setup.text: A young scientist wants to test the water of a pool believed to heal illness.

choices.label: Take a small sample with community permission.
Respect the custom and do not sample.
Ask an elder to supervise observations.
Invite volunteers to describe their experiences.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The sample reveals unusual minerals but no proof of healing.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The test is inconclusive, and the scientist reports it honestly.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The scientist regrets a missed opportunity.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The two record stories and physical conditions together.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They disagree about what the observations mean.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The accounts reveal both relief and disappointment.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The reports are too inconsistent to establish a cause.
